recognize_zh: 標示為 CD20 的染色中，中央一團小淋巴球結節的細胞核與膜幾乎沒有棕色染色，只有結節內零星、細網狀的淡棕色訊號；這與脾邊緣區淋巴瘤應有的強 CD20 陽性不符，可能是標示錯誤或為其他陰性標記。
features: Nodular aggregate of small uniform lymphoid cells surrounded by spindled stroma
Lymphoid cells are essentially unstained (no membranous positivity)
Faint, fine granular/reticular brown signal confined to the nodule, resembling a dendritic meshwork pattern
describe_en: Immunohistochemistry labeled as CD20 shows a nodular aggregate of small lymphoid cells in which the lymphoid cells lack membranous staining, with only faint, fine reticular brown signal within the nodule and a negative spindled background. This pattern contradicts the strong membranous CD20 positivity expected in splenic marginal zone lymphoma. The image is discordant with its label and more likely represents a negative or dendritic-cell-restricted marker (such as CD23 or CD21 staining a follicular dendritic meshwork) or a failed stain; correlation with the case's actual CD20 slide is required.

ddx.vs: A fine reticular signal between unstained lymphocytes is the pattern of FDC markers, not of membranous CD20 on B cells.
After anti-CD20 therapy, B cells may lose CD20 but remain PAX5/CD79a-positive.
A CD20-negative nodule could be T-cell rich, which would be confirmed by CD3 positivity and PAX5 negativity.
